0kaique0cr: Emil Kaique arrived at U-F18 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Emil Kaique did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Emil Kaique of the Hegemony and Teodor "Parson" Kobakk of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Chalk Pits. It is getting crowded.
Emil Kaique offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Wiring party. Emil Kaique held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at U-F18, and everyone came back.
Emil Kaique held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.

At U-F18 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Emil Kaique turned around and took a shovel blow. Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord (@sea_ofsoup).
Emil Kaique returned to U-F18 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Rumour reached U-F18 that the war would be over by spring. Emil has heard it before. So has everyone.
_kyrachanxq: Day 10. The corporal put Albin Kyrachanxq beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Albin Kyrachanxq tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Albin Kyrachanxq folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Albin Kyrachanxq shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Henrik Jdavidfranci of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Albin Kyrachanxq kept the tin.
Albin Kyrachanxq held the mirror while Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Albin Kyrachanxq fired at a movement across the wire at T-F3. The man went down: Tobias Northerncoun, grazed. A clear shot from T-F3. Albin Kyrachanxq gravely wounded Dietrich Wendigoarms and slid back down below the parapet.
Albin Kyrachanxq checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Albin Kyrachanxq measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Dawn watch. Albin put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Cyril Duncan, badly wounded.
_nvd87_: Walter Nvd arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in Q-F18 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Walter Nvd hums hymns when frightened. Today, under fire at Verdel Ridge, that habit was the only steady thing in Q-F18. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Walter Nvd wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Walter Nvd had Dietrich Rmr of the Concord in the sights at the Drowned Farm for a long second. Dietrich Rmr was lighting a pipe. Walter Nvd let the match burn all the way down.
Walter Nvd was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Walter Nvd's ear at Q-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one.
Walter Nvd returned to Q-F18 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Walter Nvd fought Otto Taylocirapto in a trench no wider than a door. Walter Nvd came home with Otto Taylocirapto's cap badge. (@taylociraptor) The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Walter Nvd was missing. At dawn they saw Walter Nvd lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab of the Concord (@stinkyzebraballs).
Another member of the House of Nvd reached the line: Bastian "Tin" Nvd. He asked where Walter Nvd had slept, then chose a different corner.
Bastian "Tin" Nvd and Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Bastian and Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
a_k_biwott: Edmund "Hollow" Biwott unpacked a bullet that missed him at S-F8. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott answered the first call, number 96 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Gideon Bao of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Edmund "Hollow" Biwott kept the tin.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott and Otto Alexanderbat tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F8 is up. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott and Nils Photo compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A supply man offered Edmund "Hollow" Biwott a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Edmund "Hollow" Biwott lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.

Edmund "Hollow" Biwott was on the dawn watch at S-F8 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Edmund "Hollow" Biwott was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Emil Galvanooooo of the Hegemony (@galvanooooo). Edmund "Hollow" Biwott made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott crawled the last yards. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The medics called Edmund "Hollow" Biwott 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott is back on the line. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.

Edmund "Hollow" Biwott was hit in the forearm at S-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes of the Hegemony (@mannnylopes).
The wound on Edmund "Hollow" Biwott's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

The flare went up just as Edmund "Hollow" Biwott reached the Hegemony parapet. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott jumped down first. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob was the man waiting there, and Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob fell. (@cornkkob) Edmund "Hollow" Biwott came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Edmund tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.
avtomat_rr: Tobias Avtomat was a dance-hall violinist in Marrow Fen until the posters went up. He came to S-S10 with a dented harmonica, and within a day the whole squad knew that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
The colonel asked who held the line at Hill 304 last night. Every finger pointed at Tobias Avtomat. Lance Corporal.
Tobias Avtomat agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
During a lull at the Brickworks, Tobias Avtomat called across from the Concord line. Zeno Irl answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The artist tried again while Tobias Avtomat read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Tobias Avtomat watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Tobias Avtomat had just lit a cigarette at S-S10 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Hume of the Hegemony (@hunnnter_hume). The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias Avtomat is number 389 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Tobias Avtomat wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Tobias Avtomat's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning. A letter from home reached Tobias Avtomat before dusk. Tobias Avtomat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A medic stopped by Tobias Avtomat's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Tobias Avtomat had gone back to S-S10. Tobias Avtomat reported for duty as a stretcher bearer. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Tobias Avtomat (Concord) and Lucien Markusapina (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Blackwater Canal. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Machine-gun fire swept S-S10. Tobias Avtomat took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Matthias "Brick" Scuffx of the Hegemony (@scuffx28).
The bearers moved Tobias Avtomat's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Tobias Avtomat returned to S-S10 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
At Verdel Ridge, Hugo You (Hegemony) saw Tobias Avtomat (Concord) washing a shirt in a puddle. Neither fired, and the shirt was clean by noon.
baroosal: They issued Hugo Baroosal a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
There is a sniper across the way the men call Grey Hat. Three helmets went up on sticks today. Grey Hat hit all three. Hugo Baroosal watched where the shots came from.
Hugo Baroosal fired at the enemy dawn watch from P-F1. Wendel Shitter was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Hugo Baroosal lay in the ruins of the Ossuary Wood all day. Grey Hat did not fire once. Neither did Hugo Baroosal. Both of them know.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Hugo Baroosal aimed a step ahead and fired: Oskar Xxirosasxx, grazed. Hugo Baroosal was hit in the hip at P-F1. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Florian "Brick" Paris of the Concord (@emile_in_paris).
The stretcher Hugo Baroosal lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Hugo Baroosal is back at P-F1, and someone else is lying in that dent now.

Hugo Baroosal took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at P-F1, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Walter Chandlerz of the Concord (@the_skyler_of_chandlerz). Hugo Baroosal lies on a stretcher in the communication trench. All day, men step past carrying food and ammunition the other way.
Hugo lay a night and a day on a stretcher in the open trench. Then he stood up, shook out the blanket and went back to P-F1.
deanc_67: Teodor Deanc joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Teodor Deanc during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A rat stole Teodor Deanc's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Teodor Deanc had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Clement Jewnipers crossed it, Teodor Deanc fired. Clement Jewnipers was grazed.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Teodor Deanc lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F18, Teodor Deanc listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Teodor Deanc raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Teodor Deanc is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Teodor Deanc was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan). Teodor Deanc rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Gideon Allistofeari was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Teodor Deanc walked back up the communication trench to R-F18, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Teodor Deanc was on the dawn watch at R-F18 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Teodor Deanc was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ivo Fous of the Hegemony (@le_photographe_fous). Teodor Deanc died in bed just before dawn. The orderly closed his eyes and wrote the time on the chart.
Ulrich Deanc put a bullet that missed him beside the bunk. Someone who had known Teodor Deanc helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Ulrich Deanc fired once through the steel loophole at R-F18 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Teodor Allistofeari was gravely wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich Deanc is number 181 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Ulrich Deanc watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Ulrich Deanc wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Ulrich Deanc used it. Quentin Souptime was badly wounded.
Ulrich Deanc had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges, gravely wounded.
After the shelling at R-F18, nobody could account for Ulrich Deanc. His kit remains beside the bunk.
The sentry nearly shot Ulrich Deanc coming in through the wire. He had been lost near the Ossuary Wood for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
Ulrich Deanc was on watch at R-F18 when the night raid hit. The men found Ulrich Deanc at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt Datoneperson of the Hegemony (@datoneperson01).
The House of Deanc sent Quentin Deanc after Ulrich Deanc. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Quentin Deanc tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Quentin. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
exact_change_only: Emil Only arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Emil Only helped stack spare sandbags at S-C7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Emil Only spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Verdel Ridge someone else was digging too. Emil Only got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 663. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Emil Only kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Emil Only set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Emil Only waited for the password before answering.
Yann Donkay of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at Calvary Farm. Emil Only of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
A recruit asked Emil Only how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Emil Only approved the method.
Emil Only and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
Emil shored up a collapsing wall at S-C7 with planks from an old door. It held. It still had a number on it.
fossileyezd: They issued Albin Fossileyezd a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. After what happened at Grey Mill, Albin Fossileyezd asked to serve as a field cook. Nobody argued.

Albin Fossileyezd watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Fossileyezd. Albin Fossileyezd read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F11. Albin Fossileyezd has learned to walk bent double.
Albin Fossileyezd and Bram "Button" Nailonailon compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The cook borrowed Albin Fossileyezd's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Anselm Jdanieltzn owes Albin Fossileyezd so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Albin Fossileyezd was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Albin Fossileyezd lost a boot in the trench. Bram "Button" Nailonailon found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.

Albin Fossileyezd of the Concord and Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Hill 304. It is getting crowded. A letter for Albin Fossileyezd came with a photograph. Albin Fossileyezd looked at it for a long time and said nothing. Albin Fossileyezd asked to leave the field cooks and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
The machine gun jammed at P-F11. Albin fixed it in the dark with a pocketknife and a lot of patience.
gian_dcf: Florian Dcf signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at P-F15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Florian Dcf shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Clement "Saint" Xoromevert stood up to sing louder, and Florian Dcf fired. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert was grazed. The singing stopped.
Florian Dcf held the mirror while Gideon "Hollow" Jokes shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Florian Dcf was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too.
Florian Dcf raised his head for a heartbeat too long at P-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Oskar Ohl of the Concord (@mika__ohl).
Florian Dcf was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.

A bullet went through Florian Dcf's upper arm at P-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Isidor Gallianrecon of the Concord (@gallianrecon). Florian Dcf was killed on watch at P-F15. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Isidor Gallianrecon of the Concord (@gallianrecon).
The House of Dcf sent another. Dorian Dcf, brother of Florian Dcf, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Dorian worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
goober_train: Tobias "Whistle" Train came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. Tobias "Whistle" Train asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Tobias "Whistle" Train borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home reached Tobias "Whistle" Train before dusk. Tobias "Whistle" Train read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is lost. Tobias "Whistle" Train heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Tobias "Whistle" Train wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. A letter from home reached Tobias "Whistle" Train before dusk. Tobias "Whistle" Train read it twice and slept a little easier.

The water jacket hissed as Tobias "Whistle" Train fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Zeno Kubawoj was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Tobias "Whistle" Train before dusk. Tobias "Whistle" Train read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias "Whistle" Train crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at U-F18 holds again. A bullet found Tobias "Whistle" Train at U-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane of the Hegemony (@bachir_abderahmane). Tobias "Whistle" Train was killed outright at U-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane of the Hegemony (@bachir_abderahmane).
A letter came with Emil Train: "I am Tobias "Whistle" Train's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Emil Train was faster. Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos was grazed. A letter from home reached Emil Train before dusk. Emil Train read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Train snores. Otto "Spark" Kraljmk does not. Spark now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. The letter for Emil Train was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Emil Train liked the crossed-out parts best.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Emil Train as a story about a general. The ending was the same. The runner said a letter for Emil Train had come up with the ammunition. Emil Train went to get it before the ammunition.
Ulrich Kraljmk saw Emil Train freeze up on the fire step at Verdel Ridge. Ulrich said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
hjalmarguldberg: Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at S-F2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb learned that a crate of officers' wine is stored in the cellar at battalion headquarters. He has been making careful drawings.

Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb accepted it as a review. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb volunteered for a supply run to headquarters. He came back with exactly what was ordered and a suspiciously large coat.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
The whole of S-F2 ate well tonight. a crate of officers' wine has been reported missing. Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb has been reported as a very good cook.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 283. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb kept Walter Stjohn awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Lucky could have walked there blind.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
A bullet went through Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb's sleeve at S-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Anselm "Saint" Davis of the Concord (@lucas_davis1775).

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb in the open at S-F2. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Emil Nayam of the Concord (@n.nayam2). Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb was hit at S-F2 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Emil Nayam of the Concord (@n.nayam2).
Another member of the House of Hjalmarguldb reached the line: Bastian Hjalmarguldb. He asked where Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb had slept, then chose a different corner.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Bastian Hjalmarguldb closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Bastian and Dorian "Mole" Guapoo made a pact: whoever got leave first would visit the other's mother. They shook on it.
kigh_as_a_hite: On Day 10, Pavel Hite arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Pavel Hite spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Hite watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Pavel Hite lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Pavel Hite. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Pavel Hite tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at U-F6 is up. Pavel Hite saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F6 and fired once. Karel Slayer was gravely wounded.
the Parson the crow follows Pavel Hite along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.

Pavel Hite went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Bastian Murphy put up a fight, but not for long. (@odysseus_murphy) The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Pavel Hite fought Bastian Missyandloga in a trench no wider than a door. Pavel Hite came home with Bastian Missyandloga's cap badge. (@missyandlogan) A bullet grazed Pavel Hite's ribs at U-F6. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Arno Ren of the Hegemony (@s1mply_ren).
Three days with a bandage, and Pavel Hite is back at U-F6. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Somebody in U-F6 wanted to shoot the Parson for the pot. Pavel stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
local_hafu_goober: Wendel Goober took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. The runners took Wendel Goober in on a busy morning in R-S7. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Wendel Goober ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin Carlson fell asleep on watch. Wendel Goober took over without waking Valentin, and told the sergeant nothing. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin Carlson lost a boot in the trench. Wendel Goober found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Goober jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Gideon Bao. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@d4rth_bao) Wendel Goober went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Teodor Shadowizard did not get up again. (@shadowizard__) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Wendel Goober snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Wendel Goober free. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel Goober wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel Goober's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-S7 the same hour. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel Goober is number 449 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Goober watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Wendel Goober was hit in the forearm at R-S7. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Goober is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close. Wendel Goober's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Wendel Goober spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-S7 is closed now. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Goober and Matthias World split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home found Wendel Goober before the night shift. Wendel Goober folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Goober came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. The letter for Wendel Goober had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Wendel Goober kept them.

Wendel Goober came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A thin letter reached Wendel Goober. Only five lines long, and Wendel Goober knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Wendel slipped on the duckboards at R-S7 just as a bullet went by. He lost some skin from the fall and none from the bullet. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). Across from R-S7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Wendel saw it. Dietrich Yoollyfox was grazed. The letter for Wendel was mostly about the weather at home. Wendel read that part twice too.
marcello.normale: Karel "Tin" Normale, a fisherman from Ashford Vale, was sent forward on Day 8 to fill a gap in S-S15. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
A beetle crawled across Karel "Tin" Normale's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.

Karel "Tin" Normale threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was down and screaming for a medic. (@wiwiwib3) Karel "Tin" Normale was on watch at S-S15 when the night raid hit. The men found Karel "Tin" Normale at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008).
The papers say Florian Normale. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Karel "Tin" Normale's eyes. Nobody in S-S15 argues.

Florian Normale reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Dick of the Hegemony (@dick_j0b). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian Normale answered to number 542. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Florian Normale wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Florian Normale walked back up the communication trench to S-S15, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Florian Normale lay buried at S-S15 for long minutes before anyone could dig him out. Now every minute counts. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Florian Normale. He was asleep before they set him down. Florian Normale is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
Florian Normale lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Florian Normale returned to S-S15 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Florian Normale worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Florian Normale and Silas White carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Florian tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
marks89kk: Gideon "Ghost" Marks was a choir singer in Halden until the posters went up. He came to R-F21 with a photograph gone soft at the edges, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats. Orders assigned Gideon "Ghost" Marks to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed fixed the strap on Gideon "Ghost" Marks's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home found Gideon "Ghost" Marks before the night shift. Gideon "Ghost" Marks folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon "Ghost" Marks traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A letter from home found Gideon "Ghost" Marks before the night shift. Gideon "Ghost" Marks folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F21, Gideon "Ghost" Marks listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Gideon "Ghost" Marks fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Ivo Hohne, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Gideon "Ghost" Marks offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. A letter from home found Gideon "Ghost" Marks before the night shift. Gideon "Ghost" Marks folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon "Ghost" Marks was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F21. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09). Gideon "Ghost" Marks fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Benedikt Kfg was badly wounded.
Gideon "Ghost" Marks no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F21 in the middle of the night. Gideon "Ghost" Marks met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton).

Marek Marks came to the front because his father Gideon "Ghost" Marks never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges. The transfer made Marek Marks a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A round came through the loophole Marek Marks was watching at R-F21 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Hugo "Mole" Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). Two shots, one miss. The second found Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder, grazed. Marek Marks cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The bearers reached Marek Marks at R-F21 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Hugo "Mole" Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg).

Florian Marks had heard about Marek Marks's courage. At R-F21, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian Marks is number 308. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F21. Florian Marks has learned to walk bent double.
A bullet clipped Florian Marks's helmet at R-F21 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Teodor Raider of the Hegemony (@easy_raider_).
Back on the fire step at R-F21. Florian Marks says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Florian Marks waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Olotro was grazed.

A bullet went through Florian Marks's sleeve at R-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel). Across from R-F21, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Florian Marks saw it. Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder was grazed.

Florian Marks was hit in the hip at R-F21. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated). A single shot at R-F21. Florian Marks sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated).
Ulrich "Mole" Marks arrived carrying the family name of Florian Marks. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A sniper's bullet hit Ulrich "Mole" Marks at R-F21. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Ulrich "Mole" Marks was killed at R-F21 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_).
Silas "Rabbit" Marks joined R-F21 under the shadow of Ulrich "Mole" Marks's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A round went through Silas's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Matthias Cashbandicoo of the Hegemony (@cashbandicoot3). Silas fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F21. Walter Davebowlton was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
mcrae_angus: In Esterhaus, Roland Angus was a dance-hall violinist. In S-S4, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a dance-hall violinist again.

Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Roland Angus helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Angus. Roland Angus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The men at S-S4 heard Roland Angus call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Felix Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._). Roland Angus was killed outright at S-S4, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Felix Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._).
Isidor "Doc" Angus asked about Roland Angus on arriving at S-S4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Isidor "Doc" Angus of the Concord and Emil Yijoon of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor "Doc" Angus. Isidor "Doc" Angus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Isidor "Doc" Angus got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 515. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Isidor "Doc" Angus watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Orders came through: Isidor "Doc" Angus is a stretcher bearer now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

A bullet hit Isidor "Doc" Angus in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-S4. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A single shot at S-S4. Isidor "Doc" Angus sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233).
Casimir Angus had heard about Isidor "Doc" Angus's courage. At S-S4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Casimir Angus carried three men out of S-S4 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Angus. Casimir Angus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir Angus saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Angus. Casimir Angus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A patient at the aid post asked Casimir Angus for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Angus. Casimir Angus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round came through the loophole Casimir Angus was watching at S-S4 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony (@franek.szymanski.376). Casimir Angus got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Casimir Angus died waiting. The men at S-S4 have not stopped talking about it.
A letter came with Oskar Angus: "I am Casimir Angus's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A bullet skipped off a rock and cut Oskar's ear at S-S4. He cursed, wrapped it in a sock, and stayed at the post. Shot by Walter "Parson" Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2). A letter came for Oskar with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Oskar pinned it to the dugout wall.
noobly97: Nobody asked Viktor Noobly why he came. Nobody in S-S13 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Viktor Noobly won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in S-S13. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Viktor Noobly said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Viktor Noobly folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Rematch. Viktor Noobly lost everything he won, plus his mother's thimble. The whole dugout watched. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Noobly is number 472. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Viktor Noobly did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Viktor Noobly won back his mother's thimble and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
Viktor Noobly moved to a new hide at S-S13 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Norbert Bwk, grazed.
Viktor Noobly found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Jonas Ybarry stood up to sing louder, and Viktor Noobly fired. Jonas Ybarry was badly wounded. The singing stopped. A sniper's bullet hit Viktor Noobly at S-S13. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0). Viktor Noobly was killed at S-S13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0).
Hugo Noobly came to the front because his cousin Viktor Noobly never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.
Hugo Noobly carried in young Anton, who lied about his age to enlist. young Anton kept asking whether his mother would be told.
A round went through the rim of Hugo Noobly's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Karel Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8).
The wound on Hugo's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
oscarwildelypoordecisions: Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely reached N-F18 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Bone Quarry. Severin Stry of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Henrik Nes lent Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely and Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Someone in N-F18 asked Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely about Lindenbruck. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

A sniper's bullet hit Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely at N-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Zeno "Saint" Dir of the Hegemony (@alex_rose_dir). Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Karel Ingvaldsen was badly wounded. Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely was killed outright at N-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Zeno "Saint" Dir of the Hegemony (@alex_rose_dir).
Bastian "Spark" Oscarwildely took the same post at N-F18 where Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Bastian "Spark" Oscarwildely fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Roland Creel, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Bastian's ear at N-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Walter "Spark" Llibrecommel of the Hegemony (@llibrecommellair).
return_of_the_necrowizard: Nobody saw Clement Necrowizard arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in V-F8, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Someone in V-F8 asked Clement Necrowizard about Greyhallow. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

Clement Necrowizard went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Anselm "Button" Jacobhoekstr was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@jacobhoekstra22) Clement Necrowizard went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Clement Necrowizard anyway.

The cook borrowed Clement Necrowizard's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. Clement Necrowizard got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

Clement tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. Clement found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Clement read it while the kettle boiled.
simon_vylet: Gideon "Whistle" Vylet came up on Day 3 carrying news from Rosenau. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Gideon "Whistle" Vylet folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F17 and grazed Gideon "Whistle" Vylet's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges of the Hegemony (@zgeorges11).
Gideon "Whistle" Vylet no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Gideon "Whistle" Vylet brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Gideon "Whistle" Vylet kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Gideon "Whistle" Vylet watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Gideon "Whistle" Vylet got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

A bullet hit Gideon "Whistle" Vylet in the neck at R-F17. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). Gideon "Whistle" Vylet was killed at R-F17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).
The House of Vylet sent Yann Vylet after Gideon "Whistle" Vylet. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Yann Vylet gave Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr the last match in the trench. Mole used it to light a candle so that Yann could finish a letter.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Yann Vylet only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F17, then nothing but pain. Raider: Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). Blackwater Canal is lost. Yann Vylet heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Yann Vylet walked back up the communication trench to R-F17, slower than before, but on his own feet. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Yann Vylet answered to number 174. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Yann Vylet wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Yann Vylet. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Yann Vylet waited for the password before answering.
Dorian Kelvincornbr and Yann Vylet made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Lucien Theramblingb (Hegemony) and Yann Vylet (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Verdel Ridge for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Yann Vylet was on the dawn watch at R-F17 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Yann Vylet was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Tobias Jeeves of the Hegemony (@jeeves2121).
Yann Vylet came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
A thin gray kitten wandered into R-F17 and hid in Yann's helmet. He gave it a spoon of condensed milk.
thomas833874: The sergeant gave Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 6 or any other.
At the Brickworks, Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas and Severin Heheheha exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Shrapnel at the Sunken Road. Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas walked back up the communication trench to R-S6, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Oskar Meloche, badly wounded. A bullet hit Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas's belt buckle at R-S6 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas is number 456. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet struck Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas below the ribs at R-S6. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas fell at R-S6 and never moved again. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h).
The House of Thomas sent another. Matthias Thomas, father of Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Matthias Thomas said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Matthias Thomas owes Clement Breadcrumb so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Matthias Thomas watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
Matthias Thomas of the Concord and Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Hanging Bridge now wait for it before they sleep.
Matthias Thomas repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S6 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home.
Matthias tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Halden. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
tpackterrorist: Matthias Tpackterrori arrived with the Day 11 draft, carrying a key to a house that is no longer there and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Grey Mill is lost. Matthias Tpackterrori heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Matthias Tpackterrori gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Matthias Tpackterrori fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Quentin Edenfield was grazed. Matthias Tpackterrori ate breakfast without a word.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Matthias Tpackterrori tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at V-F9 is up.

Matthias Tpackterrori had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Dorian Ollybats was badly wounded. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Matthias Tpackterrori across the shin at V-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Leopold "Tin" Jaxk of the Hegemony (@mr_jaxk1). A letter from home reached Matthias Tpackterrori before dusk. Matthias Tpackterrori read it twice and slept a little easier.
Back on the fire step at V-F9. Matthias Tpackterrori says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Matthias Tpackterrori waited for the password before answering.
Matthias had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Clement Ollybats, badly wounded.
verstlisaverst: The old hands of R-F5 have been here since Day 1. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver has been here since Day 4. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Benedikt Calderthebal and Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home reached Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver before dusk. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver kept watch so that Teodor Roos could sleep. Then Teodor kept watch so that Tin could. Neither slept. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A bullet clipped Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Raptor of the Concord (@raptor2561).
The medics cleaned Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F5.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp of the Concord (@gavinlordofpugs).

The wound on Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F5 and grazed Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Henrik Davidsonmars of the Concord (@davidsonmarshall). The clerk counted the names twice. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver is number 245 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F5 changed before the cheering ended. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver shouldered another load.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver rejoined the squad at R-F5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
A local carter understood Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver corrected the phrasebook in pencil. The carter added three useful expressions and refused to translate a fourth suggested by the corporal.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
At R-F5, Yann spent an hour looking at the same patch of ground. By dawn, he knew every stone.
xojiakbar.abdukarimov1: Day 9. The corporal put Bastian Abdukarimov beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian Abdukarimov helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Bastian Abdukarimov's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Saint-Ash crossroads, Bastian Abdukarimov was promoted to Lance Corporal. A letter from home reached Bastian Abdukarimov before dusk. Bastian Abdukarimov read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian Abdukarimov is number 633 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Bastian Abdukarimov during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Bastian Abdukarimov took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Henrik "Smokes" Kobold, grazed. A bullet grazed Bastian Abdukarimov's ribs at S-S1. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Walter Snixx of the Concord (@snixx_93).
Bastian Abdukarimov walked back up the communication trench to S-S1, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Bastian Abdukarimov watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-S1 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Wendel Red was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Bastian Abdukarimov before dusk. Bastian Abdukarimov read it twice and slept a little easier.
Bastian Abdukarimov and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Bastian Abdukarimov fired. Pavel Josh was badly wounded.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Nils "Spark" Azok, grazed. Bastian Abdukarimov cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Bastian Abdukarimov found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
A bullet went through Bastian's sleeve at S-S1 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Summacon of the Concord (@summacon1).
